name: meadow_club
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Meadow Club, Fairfax: the peninsula theme (Stanford's Bay Area oak woodland: warm irrigated turf, cream sand, olive-brown creek, golden summer foothills outside the course, L0-L2) with F0-F2 turned from olive rough into the straw of the unirrigated native grass between the holes (from the NAIP photo; drawn where data/meadow_club/proposed/native.geojson says, config fescue_areas), a touch greener than the out-of-bounds hillsides so the line reads; mown rough in the default G2-G4 greens. Trees are peninsula's painters (live and valley oaks, eucalyptus, redwoods, pines). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
